title: The Crow Perch's grace check ('climb for the scrap') can be retried indefinitely for 1hp per failure with no cap or scaling cost, turning a 0-grace character's encounter into a pure, boring hp-tax rather than a real choice.
where: The Vale of Ash / Crow Perch — climb for the scrap
